dedupe_keys.name: usgs industrial water use for 2020 by county huc12 month and year conterminous united states

description: This USGS data release gives modelled estimates of self-supplied industrial water withdrawals for 2020 across the conterminous United States, by county and by 12-digit hydrologic unit (HUC12), monthly and annually. Industrial use here means withdrawals by manufacturing facilities in NAICS 31 to 33 for fabricating, processing, washing, diluting, cooling or transporting products, incorporating water into products and sanitation; deliveries from public suppliers are excluded. The estimates come from the USGS national water-use modelling programme, which aims at consistent, higher-resolution and updatable estimates with uncertainty. Files split surface water, groundwater and total, for counties and for two HUC12 versions (the national watershed boundary of October 2020 and a modified NHDPlus version 2). It was published on 22 April 2026 on ScienceBase as CSV files in million gallons per day with XML metadata, free under CC0. Caveats: values are model estimates, only self-supplied withdrawals are included, and only 2020 is covered. For simulation it gives industrial water demand at watershed and county scale for drought, water allocation and supply interruption models. Related catalogue records include the USGS water bottling facilities inventory and the global industrial water use dataset.
